comment: NetSurf 3.11 full-source release (netsurf-all: netsurf with its libraries libcss, libhubbub, libdom, libnsfb, libnsgif, libnsbmp, libwapcaplet, libparserutils, libnsutils, libutf8proc, nsgenbin, libsvgtiny, librosprite, buildsystem) pinned by the lead for the browser port (owner decision 2026-10-20: NetSurf). Downloaded from download.netsurf-browser.org; no download by the build, no fallback.
license: GPL-2.0 (netsurf) with MIT libraries; see each component's COPYING

zlib.use: target (NetSurf gzip content encoding, libpng) and host

libpng.use: host (framebuffer asset conversion) and target (PNG content handler, fx-24)

libjpeg.signature: libjpeg-turbo-3.1.4.1.tar.gz.sig: good signature, RSA key 7EC2DBB6F4DBF434 (The libjpeg-turbo Project, signing key for official binaries), checked 2026-10-23
libjpeg.license: IJG License + Modified (3-clause) BSD License + zlib License (LICENSE.md, README.ijg)
libjpeg.use: target and host: JPEG content handler (fx-24); C only, no SIMD (WITH_SIMD off), 8/12/16-bit wrapper sources as upstream lists them

expat.signature: expat-2.9.0.tar.xz.asc: good signature, RSA key CB8DE70A90CFBF6C3BF5CC5696262ACFFBD3AEC6 (Sebastian Pipping), checked 2026-10-23
expat.use: target and host: libdom XML binding for libsvgtiny (SVG content handler, fx-24)

libwebp.signature: libwebp-1.6.0.tar.gz.asc: good signature, RSA key 6B0E6B70976DE303EDF2F601F9C3D6BDB8232B5D (WebP release signing key), checked 2026-10-23
libwebp.license: BSD-3-Clause (COPYING) with the WebM additional IP rights grant (PATENTS)
libwebp.use: target and host: WebP content handler, decoder only (fx-24)
